coverage.ci_caveat: Leave-one-out indicators share n-1 of n calibration points and are not independent, so this binomial interval understates the true uncertainty. The training-conditional Beta below needs no independence assumption.

caveats: out-of-fold only; isotonic fit and evaluated on the same data shows near-zero error by construction
binned calibration error is a biased estimator at this sample size and is secondary to Brier and log loss
log loss clamped to [0.016667, 0.983333] because Venn-Abers produces exact 0 and 1 at the extremes
